clos.original_description: Understand the basics of TensorFlow and application of TensorFlow framework in Machine Learning, Deep Learning.
clos.enriched_description: Understand the basics of TensorFlow and application of TensorFlow framework in Machine Learning, Deep Learning. The scope includes Working with TensorFlow, Machine learning and computer vision in TensorFlow, and Coding with TensorFlow in Google Colaboratory.

clos.original_description: Understand how to build a basic neural network in TensorFlow and train a neural network for a computer vision application.
clos.enriched_description: Understand how to build a basic neural network in TensorFlow and train a neural network for a computer vision application. The scope includes Computer Vision Neural Network, Understand Convolutional Neural Networks in TensorFlow, and The techniques of Convolutional Neural Networks in TensorFlow.

clos.original_description: Understan the convolutional Neural Networks in TensorFlow, include the strategies to prevent overfitting, including augmentation and dropout
clos.enriched_description: Understand the convolutional Neural Networks in TensorFlow, include the strategies to prevent overfitting, including augmentation and dropout. The scope includes The large dataset in the Neural network, Image Augmentation, and Overfitting and solutions.

clos.original_description: Undesrstand the transfer learning and how learned features can be extracted from models
clos.enriched_description: Understand the transfer learning and how learned features can be extracted from models. The scope includes The concept of transfer learning, Create model with transferred features, and Exploring dropouts and Transfer Learning with Inception.

clos.original_description: Understand basic concepts of sentiment in text, word Embeddings, sequence model and literature
clos.enriched_description: Understand basic concepts of sentiment in text, word Embeddings, sequence model and literature. The scope includes The word based encodings in TensorFlow and Text to sequence in TensorFlow.

clos.original_description: Implementing natural language processing systems using TensorFlow
clos.enriched_description: Implementing natural language processing systems using TensorFlow. The scope includes Classifier for the sarcasm dataset, Subwords text encoder, The Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) for NLP, Exploring different sequence models, and Sequence models and literature for NLP.

clos.original_description: Understand the sequences, time series and prediction problems in TensorFlow
clos.enriched_description: Understand the sequences, time series and prediction problems in TensorFlow. The scope includes The introduction of Time series and its application; Machine learning applied to time series; Time series: Train, validation and test sets; Time series: Metrics for evaluating performance; and Time series:tips to build the forecasting.

clos.original_description: Understand how to apply RNNs, GRUs, and LSTMs as you train them using text repositories
clos.enriched_description: Understand how to apply RNNs, GRUs, and LSTMs as you train them using text repositories. The scope includes Deep neural networks for time series: Preparing features and labels; Deep neural networks for time series: build the layer neural network; Deep neural networks for time series: training, tuning and prediction; Conceptual of Recurrent neural network for time series; and Recurrent neural network for time series: input, lambda layer, learnig rate, output.

clos.original_description: Understand how to apply AI tools to complete a mini project
clos.enriched_description: Understand how to apply AI tools to complete a mini project using TensorFlow-based computer vision, convolutional neural networks, transfer learning, NLP sequence models, and time-series modeling. The project scope includes topic selection, proposal discussion, model development, model results, and presentation practice.

clos.original_description: Implement a AI project includes steps: data collection, data wrangling, exploratory data analysis, model development, model evaluation, and reporting
clos.enriched_description: Implement an AI project that includes topic selection, proposal development, data collection, model development, model evaluation, results discussion, reporting, and presentation. The outcome keeps the project workflow focus without claiming unsupported production deployment experience.
